title: Better DSF Parameters for Ascon Distinguishers
summary: The current intuitive DSF search covers only a small fraction of candidates; finding choices that yield stronger higher-order differential distinguishers for Ascon remains open.

formal_statement.body: In DSF, the current method for selecting the parameter pair $(X,\Delta)$ for higher-order differential (HD) distinguishers of the Ascon permutation is intuitive and examines only a small percentage of the candidates. Find better choices of $(X,\Delta)$ that yield stronger HD distinguishers for the Ascon permutation.

scope.domain: DSF-based higher-order differential cryptanalysis of the Ascon permutation.
parameters: (X, Δ): parameter pair selected for DSF higher-order differential distinguishers
scope.unresolved_remainder: Identify better choices of (X, Δ) that yield stronger higher-order differential distinguishers for the Ascon permutation.

citations.label: Revisiting Higher-Order Differential-Linear Attacks from an Algebraic Perspective

progress.summary: The source reports an intuitive DSF selection method that searches only a small fraction of candidates. It explicitly leaves finding parameter choices that lead to stronger Ascon HD distinguishers as future work.
citation_labels: Kai Hu et al., Revisiting Higher-Order Differential-Linear Attacks from an Algebraic Perspective
